The '''Nine Houses''' were the ruling families of [[Shikaakwa]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], those families were ruled by hereditary [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lords]] who bore the title of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]]. Until the Despot War, the Barons were the vassals of a [[Kral (title)|Kral]].
